title: Couette flow: emergent effective viscosity

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

temperature.definition: wall temperature kT_w; gas kT measured per bin (A-03)

geometry: channel periodic in x, walls at y = 0 (rest) and y = 40 (moving at U)
wallModel: planar walls, Maxwell accommodation, fixed wall temperature

reynolds.note: Re_sim = ρ U H / μ_eff (wall speed); Re_eff = ρ (γ H) H / μ_eff (velocity difference actually carried by the core, i.e. net of wall slip). Re_physical: no physical fluid properties supplied.

mach.note: Mp = U/c_p with c_p measured (results/sound-speed_sweeps.json (A φ=0.1, kT = 1, 0.2.0-p0.2))

reynolds.note: Re_sim = ρ U H / μ_eff (wall speed); Re_eff = ρ (γ H) H / μ_eff (velocity difference actually carried by the core, i.e. net of wall slip)

convergence.note: Core fraction of the reported μ_eff: 0.6. Blocks are consecutive and equal in collisions/particle.

emptySpace.note: Master prompt §20: occupancy and density extremes on cells of ~40 particles; a cell below 0.1 φ_mean in 5 consecutive samples flags POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE. Low density near open boundaries (A-18) is expected and is not near-zero occupancy.

uncertainty.note: μ_eff: ensemble over independent seeds (t-based CI); per-run μ_eff SE from block-averaged wall stress and batch-means profile fit, pooled as a cross-check.

convergence.note: Channel height, particle scale and U dependence are cases of the sweep experiment.

benchmarks.note: Chapman–Enskog + Enskog (Gass 1971) hard-disk viscosity, comparison only; the channel value includes slip/Knudsen effects.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor

acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag

acceptance.description: Energy ledger (incl. wall work and heat) closes
Gas momentum change equals wall impulse
Steady shear: equal and opposite wall stresses
acceptance.criterion: |τ_bottom + τ_top| < 3 SE (per-run block averages, pooled) in every case (FAIL if > 5)

acceptance.description: Steady shear: wall work leaves as heat (no net heating)
acceptance.criterion: net energy flux gas→walls = 0 within 3 SE in every case (FAIL if > 5)

acceptance.description: Fit quality: the core velocity profile is a straight line (a single gradient exists)
acceptance.criterion: χ² p > 0.001 for the core fit in every run (FAIL if any p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: μ_eff > 0: a shear stress proportional to the gradient emerges
acceptance.criterion: seed-ensemble 95 % CI excludes 0 in every case (FAIL if the CI lies entirely ≤ 0)

acceptance.description: Per-seed μ_eff agree within their own uncertainties
acceptance.criterion: χ² of per-seed μ_eff about their inverse-variance mean p > 0.001 in every case (FAIL if p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: μ_eff from the second half of the measurement equals the first half
acceptance.criterion: seed-paired t-test p > 0.05/2 in every case (FAIL if p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: μ_eff does not depend on the averaging window: core fraction 0.4 vs 0.6
acceptance.criterion: seed-paired t-test p > 0.05/2 in every case (FAIL if p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: μ_eff precision (PFAD-defined: the 10 % tolerance used to call flow results converged)
acceptance.criterion: 95 % CI half-width (seed ensemble, Student t) < 10 % in every case
